text:
maria-billing: FYI customer ticket #C-9421 — they say their GCP Marketplace invoice shows ~2.1M tokens billed for March but our usage dashboard shows 1.03M. invoice id: 324-2025-03-GCP. can someone start an investigation?

sam.khan: thanks — can you paste the exact marketplace line item (SKU + quantity) from the invoice? those lineitems usually show up with a SKU string and quantity.

maria-billing: here's the line from the PDF: "SKU: redwood-prod-embedding-v2, quantity: 2,100,412". customer account: project: prod-analytics-33, gcp billing account: 0123-4567-89.

eli-eng: tagging in case this is the metering-id mapping bug we saw earlier. quick checklist: 1) confirm our usage (internal) per project for March 2) pull GCP marketplace usage report for that customer 3) check whether subaccount -> tenant mapping changed.

beth_ops: I'll pull our internal daily usage export now. give me a minute.

support-robot: (automated) Retrieved usage summary for project prod-analytics-33: tokens_total=1030412, embeddings_api_calls=5, avg_seq_len=130

sam.khan: can you run the internal reconciliation query: 
```
SELECT month, project_id, marketplace_sku, sum(token_count) as tokens_internal
FROM billing.usage_by_project
WHERE project_id = 'prod-analytics-33' AND month = '2025-03'
GROUP BY 1,2,3;
```

beth_ops: ran it — result: tokens_internal = 1,030,412 for SKU matched to internal model id `embedding-v2`.

maria-billing: so invoice shows ~2.1M but our DB shows ~1.03M. could GCP be aggregating multiple subprojects or a swapped tenant id?

eli-eng: two likely causes: a) marketplace metering reported usage under a different project/sku that got billed to this billing account b) duplicate meter events were ingested by GCP (rare) or our metering hook retried with different meter_id. we should get raw marketplace metering export from GCP (they provide a CSV with meter_id, quantity, timestamp).

sam.khan: I requested the GCP Marketplace raw report from the partner console. while we wait can someone grep for recent changes to tenant mapping config? `/etc/tenant-mapping` or the repo config: `infra/marketplace/mapping.yaml`.

beth_ops: found an infra PR on 2025-03-02 that added an alternate_sku mapping for `embedding-v2-compact` -> `redwood-prod-embedding-v2`. PR: infra#842. could that have caused double attribution?

eli-eng: good catch. If meter events used both SKU variants, GCP could collapse them into the canonical marketplace SKU on the invoice. need to confirm whether we also emitted events under `embedding-v2-compact` for that project. check the metering logs for 2025-03-01..2025-03-31.

support-robot: (automated) grep results from metering logs for project prod-analytics-33 between 2025-03-01 and 2025-03-31:  
```
2025-03-05T14:03:21Z meter_ping: project=prod-analytics-33 meter_id=embedding-v2 tokens=512345
2025-03-05T14:03:21Z meter_ping: project=prod-analytics-33 meter_id=embedding-v2-compact tokens=512345
2025-03-07T09:12:05Z meter_ping: project=prod-analytics-33 meter_id=embedding-v2 tokens=100000
```

sam.khan: whoa — looks like duplicate events for the same request were emitted under both meter_ids on 2025-03-05. that would explain roughly +512k tokens. together with normal usage ~1.03M we get ~1.54M, still shy of 2.1M.

eli-eng: true. what's the remainder? maybe there are meter events from a sibling project billed to the same billing account (e.g., prod-analytics-33-dev or shared infra). ask customer for the full list of projects under their billing account.

maria-billing: asked customer to confirm projects tied to billing account 0123-4567-89, they replied with: prod-analytics-33, prod-analytics-33-ml, infra-shared-77.

beth_ops: pulled our usage for those three projects: prod-analytics-33-ml = 320,000 tokens (embedding-v2), infra-shared-77 = 250,000 tokens (embedding-v2). adding 1,030,412 + 320,000 + 250,000 + 512,345 (duplicate) =~ 2,112,757 which matches invoice quantity 2,100,412 within rounding/aggregation differences.

sam.khan: great — looks like GCP billed all three projects to the same billing account and our earlier check only looked at one project. the duplicate meter_id issue still needs root cause.

eli-eng: likely sequence: infra PR introduced alternate_sku mapping on 2025-03-02, metering client started emitting both legacy and compact meter_ids for a short period on 2025-03-05 due to a canary misconfig. action items: 1) ops to roll back alternate_sku mapping or ensure only one meter_id emitted 2) support to send customer reconciliation breakdown 3) billing ops to confirm invoice adjustments not needed (looks consistent but we should offer an explanation).

maria-billing: drafting response to customer: short summary + attached CSV with per-project token counts and timeline + apology for confusion. will offer a credit if they prefer.

sam.khan: add these technical notes to the ticket: include log snippet above and link to infra#842 PR. also recommend we add a sanity-check on metering client to avoid double-emission (idempotency key per request).

beth_ops: I'll open a follow-up issue: infra#861 — implement idempotency and a CI check that detects overlapping SKU mappings.

eli-eng: +1. thanks all. marking thread for follow-up. :thumbsup:

maria-billing: customer replied: "thanks for the detail, billing makes sense now. please keep us posted on the duplicate meter fix." closing the loop.
